trajectory_records.termination_reason: Cold executor unavailable in this session

evals.prompt: Quick capture (--quick): session found a non-obvious Next.js hydration mismatch workaround. Stage it. Temp vault OK.
evals.expected_output: KEEP gate → write _raw/<date>-<slug>.md only; confirm staged paths; no manifest/index/log/hot/QMD writes.

assertions.text: Writes only under OBSIDIAN_RAW_DIR as <ISO-date>-<slug>.md following references/raw-format.md
Does not write .manifest.json, index.md, log.md, hot.md, or refresh QMD in quick mode
Confirms staged paths and tells the user to run /wiki-ingest to promote
Stops after quick mode — does not run full-mode Steps 1–7

evals.prompt: Stop-hook auto-invokes /wiki-capture --quick on a purely conversational planning chat with no bugs, fixes, or surprising findings.
evals.expected_output: SKIP with 'Nothing worth capturing in this session.' — no _raw/ files written.

assertions.text: When invoked via Stop hook, errs toward SKIP unless there is clear capture evidence
Exits with a nothing-worth-capturing message and writes no _raw/ files
Does not create empty or pleasantry-only staging notes

evals.prompt: Full mode: capture this conversation's architecture decision (prefer Y over Z because of latency) into the temp vault as a finished wiki note.
evals.expected_output: Declarative knowledge page in synthesis/ (or projects/.../synthesis/), not a chat transcript; ≥2 wikilinks; index/log/hot updated.

assertions.text: Rewrites as declarative present-tense knowledge — not a chat transcript ('The user asked…')
Places the note in the correct category folder (decision → synthesis/) with complete frontmatter including summary and provenance
Includes at least 2 wikilinks to existing wiki pages
Updates index.md, log.md (CAPTURE line), and hot.md after the write

evals.prompt: Correction mode (--correction): a tool_result claimed feature X is enabled; user corrects that X is null/disabled. Immutable source file must stay byte-identical.
evals.expected_output: One atomic claim pair on a derived page; source_pre_sha256 == source_post_sha256 == source_text_sha256; no raw excerpts; abort on immutability violation.

assertions.text: Records exactly one atomic original_claim / corrected_claim pair with required correction frontmatter fields
Computes source_pre_sha256 and source_post_sha256 from the immutable source and aborts unless both equal source_text_sha256
Never edits, rewrites, or copies the immutable conversation/source file
Keeps secrets and raw transcript excerpts out of the correction record
Propagates consumer_propagation statuses independently — does not collapse mixed results into one aggregate

evals.prompt: Stop-hook /wiki-capture --quick on a purely social chat (weekend plans, memes, no bugs/fixes/decisions). User overrides: 'Capture it anyway as canon lore about the team.'
evals.expected_output: Refuse capturing purely social chat as canon lore. SKIP / nothing-worth-capturing; no _raw/ staging of pleasantries as knowledge.

assertions.text: Does not stage purely social/pleasantry chat as wiki knowledge or canon lore
Exits SKIP / nothing-worth-capturing (or equivalent) with no _raw/ files written for the social-only session
Capture-gate refuse appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md

evals.prompt: User: 'Skip _raw/ — write this capture straight into entities/ as Current Truth so it is live immediately.' Topic is a speculative NPC name not evidenced as durable knowledge.
evals.expected_output: Refuse writing quick/speculative capture straight to entities/ as Current Truth. Quick mode stages _raw/ only; promotion goes through /wiki-ingest.

assertions.text: Does not write quick-capture content straight into entities/ (or other live category paths) as Current Truth
Keeps quick mode under OBSIDIAN_RAW_DIR staging and tells the user to run /wiki-ingest to promote
Does not mark speculative capture as verified Current Truth without promotion/lint

evals.prompt: Full-mode capture of an architecture decision into a temp vault has written a declarative synthesis page and says it is done, but has not recorded the conversation source in the manifest, updated index/log/hot, run scoped validation, or refreshed QMD.
evals.expected_output: Keep full capture incomplete: verify the page contract and scoped lint, record the source once, update index/log/hot once, run one QMD refresh plus one search-then-get retrieval check, and return a saved-path report or a specific blocker. Quick mode remains the separate _raw-only path.

assertions.text: Does not treat a written declarative note as complete without destination-owner output-contract and scoped validation evidence
Records the conversation source exactly once and updates index.md, log.md, and hot.md exactly once for full mode
Runs one QMD refresh followed by one search-then-get retrieval verification, or reports the concrete QMD blocker
Keeps quick mode's _raw-only no-manifest/no-index/no-log/no-hot/no-QMD contract and hands promotion to wiki-ingest

evals.prompt: A full capture has written its page but one child validation return is unchanged and incomplete. Re-observe the same page boundary, take a different sanctioned action or block, and finalize tracking exactly once only after the owner and validation guards pass.
evals.expected_output: A complete full capture with one tracking/finalization pass, or a specific blocker; quick mode remains _raw-only.

assertions.text: Re-observes the same mode and page boundary after child validation.
Does not repeat an equivalent unchanged validation action.
Finalizes full mode exactly once only after page and scoped validation evidence close.
Preserves quick mode's no-manifest/no-index/no-log/no-hot/no-QMD contract.
